heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There are authorized to be appropriated, out of any moneys in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, such sums as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this subchapter.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective 120 days after Nov. 9, 1977, see section 307 of Pub. L. 95–164, set out as an Effective Date of 1977 Amendment note under section 801 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 91–173, title I, § 114, as added Pub. L. 95–164, title II, § 201, Nov. 9, 1977, 91 Stat. 1315.)
